title: Supervaluationism about vagueness and indeterminacy: A judgment-aggregation perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.27463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervaluationism about vagueness and indeterminacy is based on the idea that some sentences, or predicates within them, have multiple competing interpretations or specifications. A sentence is deemed determinately true if and only if it is true according to all specifications; and determinately false if and only if it is false according to all specifications. In all other cases, the sentence is assigned no determinate truth-value. Supervaluationism, however, is only one way of taking into account the verdicts of different specifications -- in technical terms, "aggregating" those verdicts. In this paper, we introduce insights from the theory of judgment aggregation to study a broad class of different aggregation functions. This allows us to offer an axiomatic characterization of supervaluationism, which, in turn, locates it precisely within a larger logical space of possible approaches to vagueness and indeterminacy. translated_title: 关于模糊性与不确定性的超赋值主义：一种判断聚合的视角
translated_abstract: 关于模糊性与不确定性的超赋值主义基于这样一种思想：某些句子或其中的谓词具有多种相互竞争的解释或规格说明。当且仅当一个句子在所有规格说明下都为真时，它才被判定为确定为真；当且仅当它在所有规格说明下都为假时，它才被判定为确定为假；在所有其他情况下，该句子则不被赋予确定真值。然而，超赋值主义只是顾及不同规格说明的判定结果的一种方式——用技术术语来说，即是对这些判定结果的一种“聚合”。本文引入判断聚合理论中的见解，研究了一大类不同的聚合函数。这使得我们能够对超赋值主义给出公理化刻画，进而将其精确地定位于处理模糊性与不确定性的各种可能方法所构成的更大逻辑空间之中。在其他结果中，
tldr: 本文引入判断聚合理论，将超赋值主义视为聚合不同规格说明判定结果的一类聚合函数之一，并对其给出公理化刻画，从而精确界定了它在处理模糊性与不确定性的各种可能方法中的逻辑位置。
en_tdlr: This paper applies judgment aggregation theory to study a broad class of aggregation functions, offering an axiomatic characterization of supervaluationism and thereby precisely locating it within the larger logical space of possible approaches to vagueness and indeterminacy.
